safety_review.findings: A fresh non-author reviewer, claude-opus-5-5, read every weigh line in all 13 banks on 2026-11-25 after the reply format B rewrite (weigh as a คิดต่อ / Next thought question). A script comparing the file to HEAD confirmed that strength and safety, keys and order are byte-identical to the bank reviewed on 2026-11-17; only weigh changed. No option is blanked. Must-fixes applied: step3.R a alt 1 and step3.W a alt 1, "If the K result is slow at a community hospital, how will you keep insulin from waiting long?" → "If the K result is slow at a community hospital, how will you chase it so insulin is not kept waiting?" (the old wording could read as starting insulin before K is known; Thai now says ตามผล); step4.W d alt 3, "After 4 hours on the current drip the acid remains; what is extra fluid not fixing?" → "After 4 hours on the current drip the acidosis remains; is too little fluid really what keeps it there?" (the Thai read as a statement, not a question, and both languages implied the extra litre was already given). Other judgments: the step2 K line (does a normal first K mean the body has enough) and the step3 lines on when to recheck K and on glucose falling before the acidosis clears are core teaching at their own step; every step3 option already carries K and step3 b names dextrose itself, so they give away no discriminating later answer. The step2 a and R b alt 2/3 trend question names no test and no step4 option, and is acceptable. Every number cited appears in the vignette, the chosen option or every variant; Thai and English agree and read as natural ward-round questions.
